findings.matrix: 23 ownership forms x three alternatives. G5 refused the foreign data-file-name but granted B START for the other 22 explicit foreign associations. These include direct/ancestor/image aria-label/title/alt/description, aria-valuetext, local/external or multiple accessible-name and description references, referenced alt, native progress label for, progress text, local competing aria-owns, and ownership which changed to A during the progress advance.

A normal localized progress label or percent cannot veto a correctly owned file. Incomplete/unsafe references may remain UNKNOWN. Keep private/accessibility text out of exported diagnostics.

findings.issue: A later original-picker change event with [another File, original File] enters the original file into the application a second time. G5 still grants START and reports inputCount=1. An empty/foreign-only list or distinct File with the same name is not another submission of this original. Do not retry or block the later independent input.
